verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses centralized CI/CD pipeline visibility, dashboards, or cross-project/organization pipeline reporting; docs mention general CI/CD build/test capability and audit-evidence collection but nothing about a unified view across pipelines/projects for a devops-lead. Missing for 10: any mention of CI/CD analytics dashboards, pipeline status aggregation across groups/projects, or org-wide DevOps reporting features.
